title: Find LinkedIn from Email — Reverse Email Lookup

emails.title: Email addresses (find LinkedIn profile for each)
emails.description: Paste work or personal emails to run reverse email lookup. Returns the verified LinkedIn profile when an exact match exists — name, headline, company, URL. Ideal for sales enrichment, recruiting, and CRM contact enrichment. Upload from CSV or paste a list.

maxEmails.title: Max emails per run (cost control)
maxEmails.description: Cap how many emails to process in one run. Default 100. Maximum 100,000. Large lists continue automatically if the run stops.

emailsCsv.title: Or paste emails
emailsCsv.description: Paste emails separated by commas, spaces, or new lines. One column is enough.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a file of emails
fileUrl.description: Upload a CSV or text file. Every email address in the file is used.

concurrency.title: Concurrent lookups
concurrency.description: How many emails to look up at the same time. Default 10.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip emails that already succeeded in an earlier run.

freshStart.title: Look up finished emails again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
